project.title: Little Red Riding Hood
project.description: StoryOS sample project demonstrating Story Graph creation and AI-assisted production workflows.

world.name: Woodland Village
world.description: A small rural village connected by a forest path to a grandmother's cottage.

characters.name: Little Red Riding Hood
characters.description: A young traveler delivering a basket to Grandmother. This character wears the red hood prop and carries the basket prop.

characters.name: Grandmother
characters.description: An elderly woman living alone near the forest.

characters.name: Wolf
characters.description: A cunning wolf who wants to intercept Red before reaching Grandmother.

locations.name: Village Cottage
locations.description: A quaint cottage in the forest.

locations.name: Forest Path
locations.description: A deserted path through a dark primeval forest.

locations.name: Grandmother's House
locations.description: A dilapidated cottage deep in the woods.

props.name: Red Cloak
props.description: A cute clothing item that would fit on a little girl's head.

props.name: Basket
props.description: A charming period picnic basket with a plaid lining.

props.name: Bed
props.description: A old wooden bed with a tall bedstead.

dialogue.speaker: Little Red Riding Hood
dialogue.text: I am taking this basket of treats to my Grandmother's house.

scenes.title: The Encounter
scenes.label: The Encounter
scenes.summary: Red meets Wolf on the forest path.

dialogue.speaker: Wolf
dialogue.text: Hello little girl, where are you going today?

dialogue.speaker: Little Red Riding Hood
dialogue.text: I am visiting my grandmother to deliver this basket of treats.

scenes.title: The Reveal
scenes.label: The Reveal
scenes.summary: The wolf has disguised himself as Grandmother and is in her bed. Through  an investigation, Red discovers Wolf's deception and reunites with Grandmother.

dialogue.speaker: Little Red Riding Hood
dialogue.text: My Grandmother. What big eyes you have.

dialogue.speaker: Wolf
dialogue.text: The better to see you with my dear, do come closer.

dialogue.speaker: Little Red Riding Hood
dialogue.text: My Grandmother. What big ears you have.

dialogue.speaker: Wolf
dialogue.text: The better to hear you with my dear.

dialogue.speaker: Little Red Riding Hood
dialogue.text: Oh Grandmother. What big teeth you have.

dialogue.speaker: Wolf
dialogue.text: The better to EAT you with!
dialogue.description: Wolf throws off disguise and leaps at Red.

sounds.title: Opening Narration
sounds.description: A warm storybook introduction over the village cottage.
sounds.spoken_text: Once upon a time, a girl in a red cloak set out to visit her grandmother.
sounds.production_notes: Intimate, reassuring delivery with a hint of coming danger.

sounds.title: Red Remembers Her Promise
sounds.spoken_text: Stay on the path and keep the basket safe. Grandmother is waiting.

sounds.title: Stay to the Path
sounds.description: A cautious traveling theme that becomes less secure as Red enters the forest.
sounds.lyrics:
Stay to the path through shadow and pine.
Carry the basket and all will be fine.
sounds.production_notes: Sparse strings and celesta; leave room for the existing scene dialogue.

sounds.title: Forest Path Ambience
sounds.description: Wind in old trees, distant birds, and subtle branch movement.

sounds.title: Wolf Approaches Through Leaves
sounds.description: Measured paw falls and leaf crunches synchronized to the Wolf's approach.

sounds.title: Wolf Reveal Sting
sounds.description: A sharp designed impact as the Wolf throws off the disguise.

sounds.title: Silence Before the Reveal
sounds.description: Drop the room tone briefly to hold Red's realization.
